scope: Residual original FD status/NOATIME authority, memfd seals with native mapped-backing waits and canonical unknown fcntl completion. Existing dup/record-lock/async-owner routes retain their actual resource requirements.

architecture.status: One original full OFD retains status, descriptor-local CLOEXEC, live inode ownership and async endpoint. Future controls use refreshed original fsuid/FOWNER after credential changes. Existing per-OFD update synchronization is retained; numeric FD reuse cannot retarget an accepted control.
architecture.seals: Source/solo share seals_description over the actual original inode. Queries and ordinary changes run inline; live mapped WRITE-seal flushes park on existing FileWork/disk execution. Writable/VM_MAYWRITE leases still reject WRITE with EBUSY. Cancellation after disk acceptance may leave the original effect, never a replacement-FD effect.
architecture.errors: Short source/solo ABI rejects O_PATH nonpermitted commands before unused argument inspection. This intentionally unifies the old session interception and Linux body error precedence. Unknown raw commands preserve EINVAL/EBADF and do not read unused guest pointers.
no_new: fake resource or errno to hide deferral
